Xaml.CdExtraOffHint.zh-CN: 整张盘只放图片。选择“音乐 + 图片”后，音乐写在内圈的第 1 区段，CD 机只播放音乐；图片写在外圈的第 2 区段数据轨。
Xaml.CdExtraOffHint.en: The whole disc holds the picture. With “Music + picture”, the music goes into session 1 on the inner rings and CD players play only the music; the picture becomes the data track of session 2 on the outer rings.

Xaml.SessionGapLegend.zh-CN: 区段间隔（导出区与导入区）

Xaml.CdExtraHint.zh-CN: 只接受 44.1 kHz、16 位、立体声 PCM 的 WAV，样本原样写入。按 Track-at-Once 写入：曲目之间有 2 秒间隔，不足 4 秒的曲目补静音。音频 CD 机只读取第 1 区段，图片区段不会被当作音轨播放。
Xaml.CdExtraHint.en: Only 44.1 kHz, 16-bit stereo PCM WAV files are accepted; their samples are written unchanged. Recording uses Track-at-Once: tracks are separated by 2-second gaps and tracks shorter than 4 seconds are padded with silence. Audio CD players read only session 1, so the picture session is never played as audio.

Xaml.CdExtraTestWrite.en: Test write (the disc is not changed)

Xaml.CdExtraBurnHint.zh-CN: CD-Extra 用 Track-at-Once 命令依次写入并关闭音乐区段，再按光驱报告的第 2 区段地址生成图片并封盘。需要空白 CD-R（或已擦除的 CD-RW）。模拟写入只检查光驱是否接受这些命令。
Xaml.CdExtraBurnHint.en: CD-Extra writes and closes the music session with Track-at-Once commands, then generates the picture for the session 2 address the recorder reports and closes the disc. A blank CD-R (or an erased CD-RW) is required. A test write only checks that the recorder accepts these commands.

仅允许空白 CD-R 或已擦除的 CD-RW。先写入并关闭音乐区段，再按光驱报告.en: Only a blank CD-R or an erased CD-RW is allowed. The music session is written and closed first; then the picture session is generated for the address the recorder reports, written, and the disc is closed. Cancelling or a power loss may ruin the disc; once the music session is closed, its music still plays in CD players. Continue?
